kjv: This people draweth nigh unto me with their mouth, and honoureth me with their lips
mine: This people honors me with their lips
note: TR adds "engizei moi ... to stomati auton" by fuller assimilation to LXX Isa 29:13; absent from Sinaiticus and Vaticanus.

kjv: came into the coasts of Magdala
mine: went to the region of Magadan
note: TR "Magdala" replaces the unknown "Magadan" of the earliest manuscripts with a known place.

kjv: made the commandment of God of none effect
mine: made void the word of God
note: TR "entolen" ("commandment", from 15:3) against "logon" ("word") in Sinaiticus (corrector) and Vaticanus.
